document_type: RAMX and NANDX commodity submission eligibility design
status: Proposed product and admission specification; not deployed, not a complete active-series manifest, and not a change to existing contracts.

supersedes.change: NANDX moves from published contract assessments of fabricated 3D NAND wafers to new, standard-production, single-die packaged 3D NAND flash chips on a contract basis, defined as RAMX defines its DRAM chips (the user, 2026-10-22: "Switch NANDX to packaged chips ... similar to ram please"). NANDX's bucket ids, cell types, densities and weights are unchanged, so its on-chain SKU list is too; RAMX is unchanged.

verdict: The nine economic buckets are a suitable granularity. Labels alone do not establish comparable prices or settlement eligibility. Add a defined comparison-series layer rather than fragmenting the economic weights.

layers.name: commodity_bucket
layers.purpose: Defines the economic allocation and hard product identity.

layers.name: comparison_series
layers.purpose: Defines a repeatable priced object or published assessment, its commercial terms and chosen statistic.

layers.name: observation
layers.purpose: Identifies one publication/event, reference period, value, provenance and revision.

layers.name: contract_eligibility
layers.purpose: Checks that this observation belongs to the contract's committed methodology, series set and reporting window.

RAMX_MONOLITHIC_CONTRACT.recommended_core: New, unused, standard-production, single-die packaged conventional DDR4 or DDR5 SDRAM ICs, with nominal die density equal to the bucket density.
RAMX_MONOLITHIC_CONTRACT.density_rule: The row density refers to the monolithic memory die. Total package density equals die density in this initial profile. Two 16Gb dies in a package do not qualify as the 32Gb monolithic row.
excluded_initially: Reclaimed, desoldered, refurbished or unknown-condition components
eTT/uTT, downgrade or untested material used as a substitute for the standard-production series
RAMX_MONOLITHIC_CONTRACT.specialty_grade_rule: Special qualification/temperature grades cannot silently enter a standard-production series. Any separately intended specialty exposure requires an explicit series profile and precommitted treatment, not classification from density alone.
RAMX_MONOLITHIC_CONTRACT.evidence_route: Published contract assessment, or direct repeatable contract-price observation only when that evidence class and series are admitted by the contract's existing objective rules. A listing or firm offer is not automatically an agreed contract price.

NANDX_PACKAGED_CONTRACT.recommended_core: New, unused, standard-production, single-die packaged 3D NAND flash ICs of the bucket's native cell type (TLC or QLC), with nominal die density equal to the bucket density.
NANDX_PACKAGED_CONTRACT.density_rule: The row density refers to the monolithic NAND die. Total package density equals die density in this initial profile: a 1Tb row is a 128GB single-die package. Two 512Gb dies in a package do not qualify as the 1Tb row, and a multi-die package of 1Tb dies is not a 1Tb chip. Preserve the source's exact density notation and documented mapping.
allow_across_separate_comparison_series: Documented standard interfaces and I/O speeds (ONFI, Toggle)
Multiple normal production revisions and layer generations
excluded_initially: Fabricated or blank NAND wafers, and wafer assessments
SSD, eMMC, UFS, memory cards, MCPs and other managed or module products
SLC or MLC rows, and planar NAND
Reclaimed, desoldered, refurbished or unknown-condition components
Downgrade, ink-die, white-label or untested material used as a substitute for the standard-production series
Wafer or die prices converted to a per-chip price using an assumed yield
NANDX_PACKAGED_CONTRACT.specialty_grade_rule: Special qualification/temperature grades cannot silently enter a standard-production series. Any separately intended specialty exposure requires an explicit series profile and precommitted treatment, not classification from density alone.
NANDX_PACKAGED_CONTRACT.evidence_route: Published contract assessment, or direct repeatable contract-price observation only when that evidence class and series are admitted by the contract's existing objective rules. A listing or firm offer is not automatically an agreed contract price.
NANDX_PACKAGED_CONTRACT.evolving_mix_rule: A documented assessment may cover multiple manufacturers and layer generations. It measures that defined assessment market. Do not label it a guaranteed constant-quality physical transaction price. A methodology change is distinct from ordinary changes permitted by the established assessment methodology.

required_common: original economic origin and exact row/locator
price_statistic, fixed before the observation window
baseline observation and positive baseline value
dram_scope: organization or expressly documented organization mix
speed in MT/s or expressly documented speed basket
grade, condition and any qualification scope
nand_scope: interface and I/O speed, or an expressly documented interface mix
grade, condition and any qualification scope
generation/layer scope when specified by the source
direct_price_scope: Payment/rebate/bundling treatment relevant to the net unit price
comparison_series_manifest.assessment_scope_rule: A submission may inherit scope from a versioned assessment definition. It need not disclose each underlying customer's MPN, order size or private contract terms. Do not invent such values.
comparison_series_manifest.ambiguity_rule: documented_mix is an affirmative scope definition, not a synonym for missing information. Unresolved core product identity, contract basis, native measurement meaning, period or statistic blocks settlement eligibility. Undisclosed underlying transaction details do not automatically invalidate an otherwise defined market assessment.
comparison_series_manifest.metadata_change_rule: Record changes. Changing manufacturer, qualification, package construction, procurement terms or selected price statistic cannot silently continue a direct comparison series. A process change that stays within the published commodity and assessment definition is not automatically a new economic bucket.
comparison_series_manifest.unit_rule: A price relative in an unchanged documented native unit is dimensionless. USD/Gb conversion is optional for display and checks and is never a substitute for comparability. An unresolved physical denominator must not be guessed or converted into an absolute chip price.

observation_fields.assessment_identity: Use exact assessment and row identity; no fabricated MPN requirement.
observation_fields.raw_capture_rule: Retain original labels and values alongside parsed fields and the evidence supporting each classification.
observation_fields.time_rule: Retrieval/proof time does not replace publication time or the economic reference period.

ordered_checks: Verify evidence provenance under the existing evidence policy.
Extract hard product and measurement fields without guessing.
Route to a commodity bucket only when its hard identity matches.
Match the exact assessment definition or direct product/procurement series.
Check evidence class and active contract membership.
Check reference period, publication vintage, chosen statistic and baseline continuity.
Deduplicate by the underlying economic event/assessment release.
Apply the already specified deterministic aggregation and missing-data rules.
routing.unresolved_action: Retain useful evidence with a reason code, but give it no settlement contribution until objective missing requirements are met.
routing.new_sources: Open submissions may introduce candidates for future contracts; they do not silently change an already-open contract's committed series set.
no_default_assumptions: Unknown grade is not standard grade
Unknown denomination is not USD per chip
Same source website is not necessarily the same comparison series
Contract-related material is not necessarily an agreed contract price

aggregation_constraints.price_relative: R_s,t = P_s,t / P_s,0 using comparable observations of the same series.
aggregation_constraints.within_bucket: Use the contract's frozen deterministic aggregation procedure. This document does not replace it with a newly invented mean or source-weight rule.
aggregation_constraints.outer_weights: Apply each economic bucket weight once after forming its bucket relative.
aggregation_constraints.deduplication: Multiple submitters, screenshots, translations, reposts or child SKU mappings of one parent assessment represent one underlying observation.
aggregation_constraints.composition_bias: Source normalization cancels stable price-level differences, not changing product/quality/customer mix.
aggregation_constraints.missing_data: Do not automatically redistribute weight when a source or bucket disappears. Expected cadence, carry-forward expiry and any delay/fallback must be fixed before activation.
aggregation_constraints.daily_vs_monthly: A daily processing run can retain an in-period monthly assessment. Re-reading it does not create a new economic observation.

illustrative_cases.submission: New standard-production monolithic DDR5 16Gb x8 component, identified MPN, contractual terms and committed comparison series all match.
illustrative_cases.conditional: Provenance, time and evidence-class checks also pass.

illustrative_cases.submission: DDR5 16Gb at a different documented standard speed from another admitted series.
illustrative_cases.rule: Same bucket is possible; it needs its own fixed comparison definition and contract inclusion.

illustrative_cases.submission: Package containing two 16Gb dies presented as a 32Gb monolithic chip.
DDR5 16GB DIMM presented as a 16Gb chip.
A standard-production chip series is replaced with eTT or downgrade material.
New standard-production single-die 1Tb TLC 3D NAND component, identified MPN, contractual terms and committed comparison series all match.
illustrative_cases.conditional: Provenance, time and evidence-class checks also pass.

illustrative_cases.submission: Defined 1Tb TLC packaged-component contract assessment at its committed statistic and reference period.
illustrative_cases.conditional: Source scope, unit continuity, provenance and contract inclusion are established.

illustrative_cases.submission: Assessment definition expressly covers several process/layer generations.
illustrative_cases.rule: Mixed scope is permissible; no exact layer cutoff is imposed. The series must otherwise qualify.

illustrative_cases.submission: Package containing four 1Tb dies (512GB) presented as a 1Tb chip.

illustrative_cases.rule: A wafer price does not become a packaged-chip observation; no yield conversion is assumed.

illustrative_cases.submission: A 1TB SSD presented as a 1Tb chip.
Matching density on a spot board submitted as a contract assessment.
A price number with no defined native unit or priced-object meaning.
Reporter submits the high instead of the committed average statistic.
Twenty screenshots or child SKU labels repeat one assessment row and vintage.
New otherwise relevant origin that is absent from the contract's committed series set.
New web proof captures an unchanged current-month assessment.
illustrative_cases.rule: Can strengthen provenance or validity checks; cannot create additional price weight.

complete_in_this_document: Nine commodity identities and unchanged weights
Routing reason codes and illustrative cases
still_required: Actual series manifests with documented scope and quotation unit
Observed comparable contract-price coverage for every bucket, especially RAMX DDR5 24Gb and 32Gb and the NANDX packaged-chip buckets
Configured internal aggregation, baseline and linking rules
Exact reporting cadence, stale/missing-data and revision policies
Implementation against the active oracle and validation using real evidence
activation.anti_overclaim: This is a specification proposal; the cases are design examples, not results of tests against the deployed pipeline.
